focus: Release coverage v4.0.0.2, v4.0.0.3, v4.0.0.6, v4.0.0.9, v4.0.0.10, v4.0.0.16 on the four hub paths, plus the first misalignment finding against sk-doc's parent-hub canon

graphEvents.label: Hub friction for operator and AI user
Off-switch coverage false for three sk-doc validators
sk-design declares outcome none outside the canon
parent-skill-check cannot be invoked by hub id

label: parent-skill-check.cjs resolves a bare hub id against the repository root, so `parent-skill-check.cjs sk-design` prints 'Advisory findings: FAIL' before 'ERROR: parent skill directory not found' and exits 2, while sk-skill-check.cjs resolves the same id and passes

release: present at v4.0.2.0 (introducing release not isolated)
label: sk-design's routerPolicy.outcomes declares a fourth outcome `none` that sk-doc's canon does not define, no consumer reads, no sibling hub declares and the router never emits (no-signal returns defer); it passes unnoticed because the enforcement check only filters for the missing base three

v4.0.0.2's 'turns off all twenty sk-doc validators' and the shared README's 'every sk-doc validator checks' are false at v4.0.2.0: validate_report.py, audit_readmes.py and check_changelog_shape.py never import the switch helper, and the last was added on 2026-11-05 after the promise

SKDOC_SKIP_VALIDATION is absent from sk-doc's SKILL.md and ROUTER.md, so the documented off switch is reachable only from a shared-scripts README, hook-flags.env and the changelog, none of which a session loads with the hub

quality-gate.cjs --no-run exits 2 with gate NOTHING_CHECKED while its help documents 0 and 1 as the verdict codes, and parent-skill-check.cjs also uses 2 for an advisory FAIL, so a caller cannot tell a planned run from a failed one

sk-design defers on 'make me a chart for monthly revenue' while routing 'chart this data as a bar chart' to sk-design-chart and 'diagram the auth flow as a sequence' to sk-design-diagram, so the request-shaped phrasing a user types falls through the verb-shaped vocabulary

Add a meta-check to the existing fleet gate that walks the validate/check/verify/audit script set and fails any script that neither imports validation-switch nor carries an allowlist row with a reason, reusing the allowlist-with-reason pattern verify-doc-claims.cjs already uses

The v4.0.0.16 config move verifies: .skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-quality/repository/quality.json (748 bytes) and .skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-ci/repository/ci.json (1657 bytes) both exist at the documented paths, and quality-gate.cjs discovers the repo config as 'repo'
Twenty sk-doc scripts import the shared validation switch, so v4.0.0.2's 'twenty' count was arithmetically right at the tag; the invariant decayed afterwards, not at introduction

sk-design, sk-code and sk-doc all carry the same five hub-router top-level fields (skill, version, routerPolicy, routerSignals, vocabularyClasses), so the misalignment is in outcome membership, not router shape

sk-prompt ships ROUTER.md and leaf-manifest.json but no hub-router.json and no mode-registry.json, so it is a single skill with content domains rather than a thin parent hub; the topic's 'four hubs' framing over-counts by one
